question: Which team won the Vijay Hazare trophy 2021 – 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh **became the latest winner of the **Vijay Hazare Trophy **winners list after defeating **Uttar Pradesh in the 2021 season.**
 
• **The Vijay Hazare Trophy** is named after the legendary Indian test cricketer, Vijay Hazare is a one-day cricket championship of the Indian domestic cricket circuit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• T**he Vijay Hazare Trophy **is an** annual domestic limited-overs cricket tournament** in **India**.
 
• It is named after the renowned **Indian cricketer Vijay Hazare**, who was one of the most successful **captains** in** Indian cricket history.**
 
• **The tournament** is organized by the** Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** and is considered one of the **premier domestic one-day competitions in the country.**
 
• **The Vijay Hazare Trophy** was first held in **2002-03,** and it was initially known as the **Ranji One-Day Trophy.**
